reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend with a holidays argument and adds isWeekendOrHoliday, but server/schedules/app.ts re-implements the weekend-or-holiday test inline instead of using a shared predicate.

duplication.why: The isWeekend || holidays.includes(dayFromDate) check appears in isWeekendOrHoliday and three more times in app.ts (getUpcomingDates filter and two branches of getDatesInRange, the second redundant with the first).

placement.why: The core adjustment lives correctly in shared/schedules.ts, but the holiday predicate is kept private there, pushing copies into the server layer.

scope.why: Restructures getUpcomingDates so daily schedules now skip weekend occurrences instead of moving them, a behaviour change beyond adding holidays, and adds an unreachable branch in getDatesInRange.

maintainability.why: The holiday rule is spread across a private helper and inline copies, holidays must be threaded by each caller (schedule-template.ts was not updated), and getNextDate's take heuristic is ad hoc.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange test weekend/holiday inline instead of a shared isWeekendOrHoliday; server/budget/schedule-template.ts still calls getDateWithSkippedWeekend without holidays.

disguised_duplication.where: getUpcomingDates reshapes the daily-skip rule into a negated filter predicate, and getDatesInRange repeats the holiday check in a second if; both restate isWeekendOrHoliday from shared/schedules.ts.

one_place.where: The rule is defined in isWeekendOrHoliday/getDateWithSkippedWeekend (shared/schedules.ts) but re-stated inline in server/schedules/app.ts, and holidays only apply where callers pass them; schedule-template.ts createScheduleList calls getDateWithSkippedWeekend without holidays.
